trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: All regions rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production.
3. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Incident opened**: SEV2 incident **INC-0002** filed for checkout-api describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the post-rollback verification. On-call has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production, so any re-deploy of it will require change-manager approval per policy.
